basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati JRF (Mechanical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Mechanical Engineering at IIT Guwahati is hiring one JRF (GATE) for the project "Development of Underwater Organism-Supported Breathing System: A plant-based approach". The appointment is for 04 months at Rs. 37,000 plus 16% HRA, a total of Rs. 42,920. A Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering with specialization in Thermal Fluid Sciences and a GATE score are essential. Apply online at the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell on or before 23th November 2026 (5:00 PM). The online interview is on 27 November 2026 at 11.00 am.

how_to_apply: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati, at https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment.
Find the relevant position by searching for the project title "Development of Underwater Organism-Supported Breathing System: A plant-based approach".
Follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.
Apply on or before 23th November 2026 (5:00 PM).
Check the application status on the application portal.

For technical assistance with the online application, the notice gives the phone number 0361-258-2759 and the email [email protected]. For any clarification, contact the Principal Investigator, Prof. Pranab Kumar Mondal, at [email protected] or +91 361 2583435.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the test and interview. No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Research and Development Section
Development of Underwater Organism-Supported Breathing System: A plant-based approach (Project No.: ICPSISPTIDF00228xSKD101A (R))
Rs. 37,000 recommended pay, HRA 16%, total Rs. 42,920; medical: No
Department of Mechanical Engineering, IIT Guwahati

content_sections.heading: About IIT Guwahati
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located at Guwahati-781039, Assam. This recruitment is issued by its Research and Development Section for a project run in the Department of Mechanical Engineering.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The qualification printed for the JRF (GATE) post is a Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering with specialization in Thermal Fluid Sciences. The notice also asks for strong expertise in both experiment and modelling of biological flows. A GATE score is essential. The notice prints no desirable qualification or experience requirement. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The recommended pay is Rs. 37,000, with HRA at 16%, making a total of Rs. 42,920. The notice marks medical as "No". The duration of appointment is 04 months. No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati JRF (GATE)
content_sections.text: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati, at https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment . Find the relevant position by searching for the project title "Development of Underwater Organism-Supported Breathing System: A plant-based approach". Follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal. Apply on or before 23th November 2026 (5:00 PM). Check the application status on the application portal. For technical assistance with the online application, the notice gives the phone number 0361-258-2759 and the email [email protected] . For any clarification, contact the Principal Investigator, Prof. Pranab Kumar Mondal, at [email protected] or +91 361 2583435.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the interview. The interview is held online on 27 November 2026 (Monday) at 11.00 am. Shortlisted candidates will be informed via E-mail about the mode of interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the test and interview. No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates.
